meta.title: Kelvin Hall: a physics museum escape game
meta.description: A 3D escape game in a physics museum: explore the gallery, search the rooms, solve six physics puzzles and collect the seals to meet Einstein's hologram.

errorPage.title: The museum could not load
errorPage.body: Something went wrong while the game was starting. Check that WebGL is turned on in your browser, then try again.

notFound.title: This room does not exist
notFound.body: The corridor you are looking for is not part of the building.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: Puzzles, clues and dialogue: the whole game uses this language. You can still change it from the title screen.

title.pitch: One night, one museum, six seals and one door. Those who get out meet Albert Einstein. The timer is running and every mistake counts.
title.hint: Keyboard and mouse, headphones recommended. Have some paper and a calculator ready: you do the maths on paper.

pause.title: The museum is waiting for you
pause.body: The timer is still running. Take back control to keep exploring.

hud.heading: Kelvin Hall, a physics museum escape game
hud.errors: {count, plural, =0 {No mistakes} one {# mistake} other {# mistakes}}
hud.progress: {count, plural, one {# seal} other {# seals}} out of {total}.

objectives.allSeals: All the seals are collected: the Hologram Room is open.
objectives.cabinetLocked: Collect the seals. The Curator's Office is locked with a four-digit code.
objectives.solveSafe: Work out the combination of the curator's safe.
objectives.useUvLamp: The curator is hiding something in the office. The UV lamp might help.
objectives.searchCabinet: The office is open. Search it, and don't forget the guard's desk.
objectives.restorePower: Put the fuse back in the gallery fuse box and reset it.
objectives.sealsLeft: {count, plural, one {# seal left to earn at the stations.} other {# seals left to earn at the stations.}}

toasts.lampAdded: UV lamp added to the notebook.
toasts.finalDoorLocked: The door needs {total} seals. You are still missing {missing}.
toasts.fuseMissing: The main fuse is missing. It must be somewhere.
toasts.cabinetOpened: The padlock gives way. The office is open.
toasts.safeOpened: The safe opens: main fuse and display case key added to the notebook.
toasts.powerRestored: The power is back on in the gallery.
toasts.benchUnpowered: Ampère's Bench has no power. The fuse box needs to be reset.
toasts.caseOpened: The curator's key opens the display case.

carnet.label: Notebook
carnet.title: Escape game notes
carnet.noClues: Nothing yet. Look closely at the paintings, the plaques and the furniture.
carnet.safeHint: Safe: potential energy of a {mass} kg mass at {height} m, in joules (g = 10 m/s²).
carnet.closeHint: Press Tab to close the notebook.

inspect.digitFound: On the back of the frame, a digit written in chalk. Added to the notebook.

codeLock.title: Four-digit padlock
codeLock.hint: Four digits, in order of time. The labels in the gallery know who lived first.
codeLock.wrong: The padlock holds. One more mistake on the counter.

safe.title: Safe
safe.opened: The handle turns. The safe is open.
safe.hintRevealed: Three digits: the potential energy, in joules, shown on the wall. The notebook keeps a copy.
safe.hintHidden: Three dials. Nothing gives away the combination, for now.
safe.wrong: The handle is stuck. One more mistake on the counter.

fuseBox.title: Fuse box
fuseBox.instructions: The main fuse is back in. Reset the breakers from the least powerful to the most powerful: the circuit cannot cope if you start with the big ones.
fuseBox.powered: The power is back. The chandeliers light up again.
fuseBox.tripped: Everything tripped. One more mistake, start again.

puzzle.hint: Answer with the mouse or with keys 1, 2 and 3. Press Esc to leave the station.
puzzle.wrongAnnouncement: Wrong answer. You can try again with no penalty.
puzzle.wrongTitle: That is not the right answer.
puzzle.wrongBody: Check which formula applies and the units in the question, then try again: there is no penalty.

diagram.expandedHint: Scroll wheel or +/- to zoom, drag or arrow keys to rotate, Esc to shrink.
